desc: Ideation complete: identify sliding-window DFS over root-to-node paths as the primary approach.
Build an adjacency list from the undirected edges, storing neighbor and edge length.
Implement an iterative DFS from node 0 to avoid recursion-depth issues, tracking current path nodes, prefix distances, and depths.
Maintain a last-seen position for each node value and a left boundary for the current unique-value window along the DFS path.
At each node, update the left boundary if its value already appears in the current path, then compute candidate path length and node count.
Update the global result with the longest special path length and the minimum number of nodes among all paths achieving that length.
Restore last-seen state and path information when backtracking from a node.
Run the current solution against the provided examples and report the SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
